data.title: 因幡巡 · 狭窄被窝里的耳边心跳
data.description: 微冷的冬夜里，两人紧紧挤在同一床厚实的棉被之中。屏幕微光映亮了被窝里的方寸天地，巡整个人紧贴在身旁，温热的气息拂过耳廓。在狭窄近距离的体温交融中，游戏操作早已乱了节拍，只剩下胸膛里如鼓点般急促的心跳。
data.action: lying closely together under blanket, blushing intensely, breathless whisper
data.lighting: soft dim glow from portable gaming screen in darkness
data.promptProse: Huddled closely under a thick duvet late at night, Inaba Meguru shares a cozy, breathless space with the viewer. The dim glow of a portable game illuminates her heavily blushing face and wide, affectionate eyes in intense close proximity.
data.animaCaption: Meguru huddled closely under the blanket with a deep blushing gaze.
